user.title: Media Bridge
user.description: Enter the address of the device running the Media Bridge app.

discovery_confirm.description: Set up {name}? A pairing code will appear on its screen.

pair.title: Pairing code
pair.description: A 6-digit code is now shown on {name}. Enter it here. Leave the field empty and submit to show a new code.

reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts the stored token. Submit to show a new pairing code on its screen.

reconfigure.description: Change the address of the device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Is the app installed and notification access granted?

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered device did not announce an ID.
abort.wrong_device: A different device answered the pairing.

show_notification.name: Show notification
show_notification.description: Shows a card on the screen above whatever is playing, optionally with a camera image, up to three buttons and pausing playback. Button presses fire the event media_bridge_notification_action.

image_entity_id.name: Camera
image_entity_id.description: Camera whose current image is shown.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: Image fetched by Home Assistant and shown on the card.

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Up to three buttons: list of objects with id and title, or plain texts. While buttons are shown, the remote controls the card; BACK closes it.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Returned with the button event, to tell notifications apart.

pause_playback.name: Pause playback
pause_playback.description: Pause what is playing when the card appears.

init.title: Media Bridge options
init.description: Needs a power mode that keeps the network connected in standby.

data.mac: MAC address (for switching on via Wake-on-LAN)

missing_overlay.title: {name}: permission 'Display over other apps' missing
missing_overlay.description:
The Media Bridge app on {name} lacks the permission needed for on-screen notifications and starting apps. Grant it via ADB:

`{command}`

missing_accessibility.title: {name}: permission 'Accessibility service' missing
missing_accessibility.description:
The Media Bridge app on {name} lacks the permission needed for remote keys, the foreground app and ending the screensaver. Grant it via ADB:

`{command}`

missing_device_admin.title: {name}: permission 'Device admin' missing
missing_device_admin.description:
The Media Bridge app on {name} lacks the permission needed for switching off from Home Assistant. Grant it via ADB:

`{command}`

missing_secure_settings.title: {name}: permission 'Secure settings' missing
missing_secure_settings.description:
The Media Bridge app on {name} lacks the permission needed for changing the picture mode. Grant it via ADB:

`{command}`

missing_bluetooth.title: {name}: permission 'Bluetooth' missing
missing_bluetooth.description:
The Media Bridge app on {name} lacks the permission needed for the connected Bluetooth devices. Grant it via ADB:

`{command}`

missing_install.title: {name}: permission 'Install apps' missing
missing_install.description:
The Media Bridge app on {name} lacks the permission needed for updating the app from Home Assistant. Grant it via ADB:

`{command}`
